'''Leof Torfinn''' is from the [[Two Rivers]].

== Appearance ==
He has deep-set eyes. He has a white streak in his hair where a scar ran, given to him by [[Trollocs]].

== Activities ==
He is part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army that defends [[Emond's Field]] from the Trollocs. He holds the Wolfhead banner before the fight.{{ref/book|4|44}}

He accompanies Perrin to [[Ghealdan]] to search for [[Masema Dagar]]. He carries the Red Wolfhead banner to the meeting with the [[Seanchan]].

He goes through the aqueduct to enter the town of [[Malden]] before Perrin begins his attack.
